subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand multimodal memory beyond opt-in `extraPaths` image/audio into PDF/video and remembered session attachments, and what consent, retention, deletion, provider-upload, and reindexing contract should gate it?
rationale: The remaining behavior is technically feasible but changes how user media is uploaded to remote embedding providers and retained in searchable memory, so automation cannot safely choose the security/product boundary.

options.title: Design gated media memory first
options.body: Define supported modalities, explicit opt-in consent, retention/deletion behavior, provider limits, result presentation, and reindex/migration behavior before implementation.

options.title: Limit core to the shipped subset
options.body: Keep current core behavior at image/audio files under `extraPaths` and close broader attachment/PDF/video memory until a stronger maintainer-sponsored direction appears.

options.title: Expand only `extraPaths` modalities
options.body: Allow a narrower follow-up for PDF/video files under `extraPaths` while explicitly excluding remembered chat-attachment retention for now.

recommendation.title: Design gated media memory first
recommendation.body: Define supported modalities, explicit opt-in consent, retention/deletion behavior, provider limits, result presentation, and reindex/migration behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The shipped multimodal memory subset and its config/docs boundary came through this owner history, making it the closest route for deciding the next boundary.
